# HoBo

> HoBo is a cloud-agnostic, AI-native hosting platform. Every canonical CLI verb has a 1:1, capability-scoped MCP tool, so an agent drives HoBo natively — the same operations a human runs. This file is generated from the canonical verb surface (single source of truth); do not edit by hand.

## Commands
- up (lifecycle): Realize the current object graph — CLI `hobo up`; MCP tool `up`
- down (lifecycle): Tear down what up realized — CLI `hobo down`; MCP tool `down`
- dev (local loop): Run against runtime-local — CLI `hobo dev`; MCP tool `dev`
- new (local loop): Scaffold a runnable SDK program — CLI `hobo new`; MCP tool `new`
- login (identity): Obtain a dev SVID through OIDC — CLI `hobo login`; MCP tool `login`
- claim (identity): Bind an anonymous deployment to an account — CLI `hobo claim`; MCP tool `claim`
- plan (read-only): Dry-run the up decision — CLI `hobo plan`; MCP tool `plan`
- verify (read-only): Run the unified Gatekeeper preflight — CLI `hobo verify`; MCP tool `verify`
- can-deploy (read-only): Diagnose producer/consumer compatibility — CLI `hobo can-deploy`; MCP tool `can-deploy`
- inspect (read-only): Render projections and time-travel views — CLI `hobo inspect`; MCP tool `inspect`
- logs (read-only): Live-tail Camp runtime streams — CLI `hobo logs`; MCP tool `logs`
- doctor (diagnostics): Report environment and portability hazards — CLI `hobo doctor`; MCP tool `doctor`
- codegen (authoring): Regenerate checked-in generated clients — CLI `hobo codegen`; MCP tool `codegen`
- build (authoring): Compile services to wasm components — CLI `hobo build`; MCP tool `build`
- collect (authoring): Run resource collection and print manifest IR — CLI `hobo collect`; MCP tool `collect`
- stub (authoring): Run with a contract-backed stub — CLI `hobo stub`; MCP tool `stub`
- drift (diagnostics): Report drift and governed remediation paths — CLI `hobo drift`; MCP tool `drift`
- add (distribution): Install a provider or listing — CLI `hobo add`; MCP tool `add`
- registry (distribution): Administer registry artifacts — CLI `hobo registry`; MCP tool `registry`
- import (migration): Adopt existing estate in place — CLI `hobo import`; MCP tool `import`
- generate (generation): Request provider generation — CLI `hobo generate`; MCP tool `generate`
- sandbox (test loop): Run a contract-backed isolated lane — CLI `hobo sandbox`; MCP tool `sandbox`
- test (test loop): Alias for the sandbox test lane — CLI `hobo test`; MCP tool `test`
- attest (governance): Produce signed external evidence exports — CLI `hobo attest`; MCP tool `attest`
- erase (governance): Request crypto-shred erasure — CLI `hobo erase`; MCP tool `erase`
- broker (governance): Resolve placements through the broker (the Conductor) — CLI `hobo broker`; MCP tool `broker`
- derivative (extensibility): Manage derived HoBo implementations — CLI `hobo derivative`; MCP tool `derivative`
- runbook (SRE): Execute or replay incident runbooks — CLI `hobo runbook`; MCP tool `runbook`

## Notes
- Auth: every MCP tool is capability-scoped to { port: hobo:mcp, resource: tool:<name>, verb: call }; deny-by-default.
- Tool outputs are inert data (ADR-0023): a result never widens the agent's authority or schedules a follow-up call.
- Onboarding: `npx hobo new <name>` scaffolds an offline project; `npx hobo up` deploys anonymously and returns a live URL (NFR-015).
- Machine-readable surface: docs.json.
